summary: Find the Green function of the Euler-type operator x^2y''+2xy'-μ(μ+1)y on [0,∞) with y(0)=y(∞)=0 using power solutions x^α; solve a separable-kernel Fredholm integral equation f(x)/√x=1/√x+λ∫0^1 x√y f(y)dy, determine for which λ a solution exists, and compare with the Neumann series to second order in λ.
